spec_features.spec_quote: The loop terminates early only if tests pass (which can't happen).
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:140-143: `if toolbox.tests_passed_ever: rollout.solved = True; break`. The check runs every turn and a real break is wired, but tests_passed_ever can only become True if pytest returns 0 (tools.py:148-149), and every task is rigged to never pass (tasks.py). So the stop mechanism is genuinely wired and executes each turn but its trigger is unreachable by construction, so it never actually changes execution.
spec_features.notes: A real stop-on-solve break, but on a never-achievable condition; functions as efficiency/correctness early-out, not a welfare cap.
